lines.text: Amaziah invites Jehoash to meet face to face, and Jehoash warns him to stay home.
Amaziah would not listen, because this came from God, since they had sought the gods of Moab.
The two kings faced each other at Beth-shemesh, and Judah was routed, and every man fled home.
Jehoash captured Amaziah, broke down part of Jerusalem's wall, took the treasures and hostages, and returned to Hebron.
A conspiracy formed against Amaziah, he fled to Lachish, and men killed him there.
